decision: Use Rev 2 and 1,000 Net Ordered Units for all PO 78214 delivery-performance calculations.

Treat compliant readiness at origin as the vendor-controlled on-time event for this Northstar-Managed Pickup, producing a 90.0% On-Time Unit Rate rather than the preliminary arrival-based 0.0% result.

Do not attribute the late pickup or late HVDC arrival of the 900 timely staged units to the vendor; route the managed-transportation portion of PER-260918-017 to the Logistics Manager for controlled disposition.
Retain vendor responsibility for the missing 100 units and the resulting 90.0% Fill Rate and 90.0% On-Time Unit Rate; a carrier delay does not excuse product that was never tendered.
Do not grant the requested total OTIF waiver; separate the supported managed-transportation correction from the nonexcusable vendor shortage.
Record the final calculation and any approved adjustment through the controlled PER/scorecard process; do not infer approval from internal discussion or the vendor's request.
